channel.title: MakcikGPT — Civic Intelligence | Arif Fazil
channel.description: Civic journalism in Bahasa Makcik. Malaysian sovereignty, resource governance, institutional integrity, and technology accountability.

item.title: Ada Apa Pada Visi dan Misi Hang?
item.description: 50-year evolution of PETRONAS vision/mission statements (1974-2025). Maps 7 vision eras from "fight like bulldogs" to "progressive energy partner."

item.title: PETRONAS Memang ATM. Tapi Siapa Jaga Mesin Tu?
item.description: Fiscal analysis of PETRONAS dividend extraction (FY2022 PAT RM101.6bn, dividend RM50bn = 49% payout).

item.title: PETRONAS DNA — Dulu Bulldog, Sekarang Anjing
item.description: Contrasts PETRONAS institutional DNA (1988–2010: integrity, teamwork, "fight like bulldogs") against current leadership reality.

item.title: Sam Altman, Elon Musk, Anwar Ibrahim — Depa Ada Akal Ka?
item.description: Questions whether three powerful leaders possess "akal budi" (wisdom) or merely power, slogans, and applause.

item.title: SEARAH Dah Beroperasi — Tapi Bocor Pun Dah Sampai Mahkamah
item.description: SEARAH (50% PETRONAS + 50% Eni Italy) starts operations 1 Julai 2026. Court hears former PETRONAS manager leaked upstream data to PETROS.

item.title: Kenapa Gas Sarawak Punya Dah Masuk Tangan Orang Italy?
item.description: Original SEARAH exposé: USD 2 shell company in London, 19 oilfields, no BIT protection, PETROS excluded.

item.title: Persoalan RM70 Bilion
item.description: Deeper investigation into SEARAH's RM70 billion deal structure, USD 6bn JP Morgan revolver, VSS/MSS of ~5,000 workers.

item.title: Iran Hormuz dan Malaysia: Rightsizing Tak Habis-Habis
item.description: Hormuz shipping disruption, PETRONAS repeated rightsizing, and Malaysia's 600,000 barrel/day import gap.
